title: 错位的时间：为什么我们总是来不及——社会系统的时间错配与可控性边界 / Desynchronized Time: Why We Are Always Too Late — Temporal Mismatch and the Boundary of Controllability in Social Systems
description:
中文. 本著作提出“时间错配”诊断框架，用以解释现代社会为什么反复出现“知道了也来不及”的结构性失败。

核心主张：时间不是背景而是变量。以 τ = 需要的最短时间 ÷ 你拥有的时间、可控性 C = 1/τ 度量“还来不来得及”；现代社会的困难不在钟走得快，而在许多个钟转速不同且无法被同一机制协调。

结构与证据：25 章、附录 A—J、42 幅图；以 Θ（租佃/抽取份额）、I（组织复杂度）、κ（地缘耦合）三根不可逆轴加一条时间轴，给出脆弱性 V 与三个情景（τ≈0.5 / 3.5 / 30），对应“精确、发散、失效”三种诊断状态。

诚实的纪律：τ 只作事后诊断与序数比较；V 的权重与数据口径逐项标注（A/B/C）；数据质量评估表明确区分“可复算”与“跨年代可比”；可证伪登记簿与数据缺口清单随书公开。

边界：不预测崩溃时点；社会中制度时间与认知时间不可独立测量，这是框架的硬边界，也是它拒绝给出“预言”的理由。

版本：2026-10-18，326 页，25 章，42 图，附录 A—J；源码与构建流程开源，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

本版更新（2026-10-18 地基版）。本版把全书的共同前提写到卷首：现实中不存在无限——无限只作为极限出现在模型里，从不出现在现实系统的实际状态里。有限性本身只说明“有上界”；它要变成“必须让出一样”，还需要三个条件同时成立：需求随规模增长、描述/组合/传递共享同一承载者、同时维持两种活动更贵（交互惩罚 ψ>0）。因此“至多取二”一律是“紧预算（K/D 有界）下至多取二”的简写；若预算增长快于需求，三项可以同时满格。

本版新增内容。第 9 章新增“有限性诊断”：四个案例共享 T_threat 与 T_policy 的时间预算；τ 的结构是 A/甲，案例数值是 C 级指示。卷首总纲把时间写成一种容量：多时钟是有限承载者各有响应上限的社会显影。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/entropy-spiral。首选预览文件：entropy-spiral-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This work presents a diagnostic framework of temporal mismatch, explaining why modern societies repeatedly fail not from ignorance but from being too late. Core thesis: time is a variable, not a background; τ = minimum time required ÷ time available, and controllability C = 1/τ measure whether a system can still save itself. The difficulty is not that one clock runs fast, but that many clocks run at different speeds and cannot be coordinated by one mechanism. Structure and evidence: 25 chapters, appendices A–J, 42 figures; three irreversible axes — Θ (extraction share), I (organisational complexity), κ (geopolitical coupling) — plus an independent temporal axis, yielding a vulnerability index V and three scenarios (τ≈0.5, 3.5, 30) that correspond to precision, divergence and failure. Discipline: τ is diagnostic and ordinal only; weights and data are graded A/B/C, and a data-quality table separates reproducibility from cross-era comparability. Boundaries: no point predictions of collapse; institutional and cognitive time cannot be measured independently. Edition: 2026-10-18, 326 pages, 25 chapters, 42 figures, appendices A–J.

What is new in this edition (2026-10-18, Finitude Edition). The common premise is now stated at the front: there is no infinity in reality — infinity appears only as a limit in models, never as a property of a real system. Finitude alone only says that there is a ceiling; to yield a trade-off it also needs three conditions: demand grows with scale, description/composition/transfer share one bearer, and maintaining two activities at once is more expensive (interaction penalty ψ>0). “At most two” is therefore shorthand for “at most two under a tight budget (bounded K/D)”; if the budget grows faster than demand, all three can be full.

New in this edition. Chapter 9 adds a finitude diagnosis: the four cases share a time budget between T_threat and T_policy; the structure of τ is A/甲, the case numbers are C-level indications. The front matter frames time as a capacity: multiple clocks are the social shadow of finite bearers with different response ceilings.
notes: 科目（中文）：经济学 Economics、系统科学 Systems Science、复杂性科学 Complexity Science、风险管理 Risk Management、国际政治经济 International Political Economy、时间社会学 Sociology of Time。语言：中文（含英文摘要）。结构：25 章，约 321 页。首选预览文件：entropy-spiral-print.pdf（印刷版）。引用格式见 CITATION.cff。
